name: flags_counts_and_dates
query: SELECT flag, count(*) AS n, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last FROM OPEN ON 2016-01-01 CLOSE ON 2017-01-01 CLEAR GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
notes: S (summarization) rows are dated the day before OPEN, the C (conversion) entry the day before CLOSE, and the T (transfer) entries like the last entry of the period. Also sensitive to whether zhang's synthetic balance-check transactions (zero-amount postings) are part of the postings table.
